content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank) build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5-30 reps. Lighter weights work, but they take more reps and more fatigue to get there.

For your 100 kg bench goal, though, you do need heavy work. Strength is specific, so you'll want to practice lower-rep sets (3-6 reps) with heavy loads alongside your higher-rep volume. 💪
